final: WITH site_avgs AS (SELECT sm.zoneref, AVG(CAST(sm.facetfaces AS FLOAT)) as site_avg_faces FROM scanmesh sm WHERE sm.facetfaces IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sm.zoneref), baseline_value AS (SELECT AVG(site_avg_faces) as baseline FROM site_avgs), site_status_join AS (SELECT sa.zoneref, sa.site_avg_faces, s.entrystat FROM site_avgs sa LEFT JOIN sites s ON sa.zoneref = s.zoneregistry), status_means AS (SELECT entrystat, AVG(site_avg_faces) as status_mean FROM site_status_join WHERE entrystat IS NOT NULL GROUP BY entrystat), kept_sites AS (SELECT ssj.site_avg_faces, sm.status_mean, bv.baseline FROM site_status_join ssj JOIN status_means sm ON ssj.entrystat = sm.entrystat CROSS JOIN baseline_value bv WHERE ssj.site_avg_faces > sm.status_mean) SELECT AVG(site_avg_faces) as avg_kept_face_avg, AVG(site_avg_faces - baseline) as avg_above_baseline, AVG(site_avg_faces - status_mean) as avg_above_status FROM kept_sites
